hero.headline: A field-built gold platform for exploration, mining, processing, and supply
hero.description: AfriGold Hub is a growing gold exploration, artisanal mining, mineral processing, and mineral supply company operating through experienced local teams, mineral-rich concessions, community relationships, and partner-ready reporting.

badge.text: Licensed operations across seven African markets

story.headline: Built from local mining knowledge into regional supply
story.description: The AfriGold Hub model was shaped by a simple observation: artisanal and small-scale gold can be highly productive, but it only becomes investable when exploration, extraction, processing, buyer engagement, and reporting are handled with discipline. We built our platform around that standard.
paragraphs: Our team combines field operators, local mining networks, finance professionals, compliance specialists, and ESG advisors who have worked across East, West, and Southern African mineral corridors.

Instead of selling exposure to a vague commodity opportunity, we give partners visibility into the actual production chain: where deposits are assessed, how ore is extracted, how recovery systems perform, how dore or refined gold is verified, how buyers settle, and how distributions are calculated.

items.title: Document everything
items.description: Every stage produces a record - from pit weight tickets to assay certificates and sale receipts.

items.title: Keep processing clean
items.description: Our gravity concentration circuits use water and density separation, eliminating mercury, cyanide, and toxic tailings.

items.title: Share the economics
items.description: Partners receive monthly reporting that connects production, sales, costs, net profit, and distribution calculations.

items.title: Protect the licence
items.description: Compliance, community agreements, and environmental controls are treated as operating assets, not paperwork.

governance.headline: Controls that make the operation auditable
governance.description: Our governance model is designed around clear records, accountable ownership, and investor access to the documents that matter.
